Linear relaxation and pre-solving domain reductions prune the search space by 80% before initiating branch-and-bound branch trees.
inferences: [INFERENCE] Incorporating dynamic warehouse labor capacity constraints directly into the MILP objective function prevents warehouse operational bottlenecks.
critical_gaps: Non-linear shipping rate tariffs (step functions based on dimensional weight breaks) require piecewise linear approximations.
